name: Northlight Home Services
note: A made up company for practice. Every person, company and email in this folder is fictional.
what_we_do: Home repair and cleaning for houses and small rental properties. Customers book an estimate visit, a crew does the job, and many customers rebook every season.
how_it_grows: By bookings. More booked estimate visits mean more jobs, more repeat customers and more referrals. Missed follow ups and messy books are the two things that hurt most.

open_roles.why_now: Leads from the website and from property managers sit too long before anyone calls them. One person should own first contact and follow up.
The owners do the books on Sunday nights. Bank accounts are reconciled late and sales tax is a scramble each quarter.
The booking and invoicing tool was built by a contractor. It needs a steady owner for bugs, integrations (payments, text messages, calendars) and new features.

tools_in_use: an off the shelf accounting package
values_in_plain_words: Do what you said you would do

hiring_rules.scoring: Only job related evidence is scored. Names, gaps in work history and the way English is written (apart from clear messages to customers) never lower a score.
hiring_rules.decisions: A person makes every yes and every no. A low score means not shortlisted now, never an automatic rejection.
